title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.34899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. translated_title: 使用潜在空间表示增强海事领域感知
translated_abstract: 本工作从地理空间基础模型TerraMind的视角，展示了地球观测嵌入在海事领域感知（MDA）中的一项新颖应用。通过直接在压缩的潜在空间表示上进行操作，而非在原始Sentinel-1图像上进行操作，该方法直接应对了日益制约业务化地球观测处理的数据引力瓶颈，这与Embed2Scale项目的目标一致。特别是，通过对压缩嵌入（即合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像的潜在空间表示）进行线性和非线性探测，用于从Sentinel-1 GRD图像中检测、定位和表征船舶。船舶检测达到了0.95的ROC-AUC，船舶定位对于长度超过100米的船舶中位误差约为300米，船舶AIS类型编码分类对多数类别达到了62%的准确率。然而，后者与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文利用地理空间基础模型TerraMind生成的压缩潜在空间嵌入，直接从Sentinel-1 SAR图像中实现船舶检测（ROC-AUC 0.95）、定位（中位误差约300米）和类型分类（62%准确率），有效缓解了海事领域感知中地球观测数据处理的数据引力瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages compressed latent-space embeddings from the TerraMind geospatial foundation model to achieve vessel detection (ROC-AUC 0.95), localisation (median error ~300 m), and type classification (62% accuracy) directly from Sentinel-1 SAR imagery, addressing the data gravity bottleneck in Maritime Domain Awareness.
